issues.issue: Did the RPD err in finding the applicant subject to exclusion under Article 1F(b) of the Convention?
issues.applicant_position: Article 1F(b) is limited to fugitives (Ward); he served his sentence and is not a fugitive, so not excluded.
issues.respondent_position: Not stated in this decision; the Minister's advice to the RPD was that 1F(b) applies.
issues.result_quote: I have no difficulty dismissing the sole argument raised by the applicant
